ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with Cheetah labeled at the very top. Below it are Coyote and Rattlesnake, further below are Jackrabbit, Cottontail, and Chuckwalla, and at the bottom are plants such as Mojave Yucca, Cactus, and Shrub. The arrows in the image generally point from plants or smaller animals to higher-level consumers; it can be seen that multiple arrows ultimately point to the Cheetah above, and no arrow shows that Cheetah is preyed on by other organisms. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from food/prey to consumer/predator. ultimate predator refers to the predator at the top of the food web that is not preyed on by other animals. Therefore, the ultimate predator in the image is Cheetah.
